outcome: mean gestational age at rupture of membrane
umbilical cord blood gas test results
cohort: The study included 211 PPROM patients classified into three groups: without diabetes, gestational diabetes, and overt diabetes mellitus.
finding: The study found significant differences in mean gestational age at rupture of membrane and delivery, labor duration, hospital stay after childbirth, severe preeclampsia, newborn weight, neonatal hyperglycemia, Apgar score, revive need, infant death, and umbilical cord blood gas test results among PPROM patients based on their diabetes status.
cross-section timing: At the time of PPROM and subsequent delivery/neonatal period.
